Evaluation : get_all_evaluations

Evaluation_GetAllEvaluations.Rd

Get a list of all Evaluations, within a given range.

Usage

synGetAllEvaluations(access_type=NULL, active_only=NULL, evaluation_ids=NULL, offset=NULL, limit=NULL, synapse_client=NULL)

Arguments

access_type

(Optional[str]) The type of access for the user to filter for, optional and defaults to "READ". See ACCESS_TYPE for the available values.

active_only

(Optional[bool]) If TRUE then return only those evaluations with rounds defined and for which the current time is in one of the rounds.

evaluation_ids

(Optional[list[str]]) An optional list of evaluation IDs to which the response is limited.

offset

(Optional[int]) The offset index determines where this page will start from. An index of 0 is the first entity. When NULL it will default to 0.

limit

(Optional[int]) Limits the number of entities that will be fetched for this page. When NULL it will default to 10.

synapse_client

(Optional[Synapse]) If not passed in, the last created instance from the Synapse class constructor will be used.

Value

A list of all evaluations, as Evaluation objects.

Errors

An error is raised if the service rejects the request or an HTTP error occurs.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
## Example 1: Get all evaluations the user has at least READ access to
    # A default call will return evaluations where the user has read access, without needing to specify access type.
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    all_evaluations = synGetAllEvaluations()
    all_evaluations

## Example 2: Get only active evaluations with a limit
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    active_evaluations = synGetAllEvaluations(
        active_only = TRUE,
        limit = 20L
    )
    active_evaluations

## Example 3: Get specific evaluations by ID
    library(synapser)
    synLogin()

    specific_evaluations = synGetAllEvaluations(
        evaluation_ids = list("9999991", "9999992")
    )
    specific_evaluations
} # }
